c1-3b-001.gate_key: adv_past | C1 | mcq | Which sentence has a mistake? | We have hoped the weather would hold, but it rained all weekend.

key.correct: We have hoped the weather would hold, but it rained all weekend.
wrong: I was meaning to call you, but the week got away from me.
I had hoped to finish the report by Friday.
They were planning to move, but they changed their minds.

item.why: A hope or a plan that did not happen, about the past: past perfect, past simple or past continuous (*We had hoped / hoped / were hoping*), not the present perfect (*have hoped*): the weekend is over.
item.why_lv: Cerība vai plāns, kas neīstenojās, par pagātni: Past Perfect, Past Simple vai Past Continuous (*We had hoped / hoped / were hoping*), nevis Present Perfect (*have hoped*): nedēļas *nogale* ir *beigusies*.
item.correct: We have hoped the weather would hold, but it rained all weekend.
wrong: I was meaning to call you, but the week got away from me.
I had hoped to finish the report by Friday.
They were planning to move, but they changed their minds.

c1-3b-002.gate_key: adv_past | C1 | mcq | Choose the correct option: When we shared a flat, Tom ___ my phone charger without asking. | was always borrowing

item.q: Choose the correct option: When we shared a flat, Tom ___ my phone charger without asking.
item.why: *was always* + *-ing* for an annoying past habit: *Tom was always borrowing my charger.* *always* goes after *was*; the present perfect does not fit a finished time (*when we shared a flat*).
item.why_lv: *was always + -ing* kaitinošam pagātnes ieradumam: *Tom was always borrowing my charger.* *always* stāv aiz *was*; Present Perfect *neder pabeigtam laikam* (*when we shared a flat*).

c1-3b-003.gate_key: adv_past | C1 | gap | I went back to my old school last summer and found that it ___ much. (not / change) |

item.q: I went back to my old school last summer and found that it ___ much. (not / change)
item.why: What you found at a past moment about the time before it: past perfect, *it hadn't changed much* (not *didn't change*).
item.why_lv: Ko konstatēji pagātnes brīdī par laiku pirms tā: Past Perfect, *it hadn't changed much* (nevis *didn't change*).
